titles_read.title: Our Island Home: A Tasmanian Sketch Book
titles_read.author: Louisa Anne Meredith
titles_read.publisher_seen: Cloth, black-stamped pine branch and cone design with gilt lettering on front board and spine (title page not photographed)
titles_read.first_edition: Hobart Town and London, J. Walch and Sons, Marcus Ward and Co., 1879. Folio, c.38 cm, about 44 leaves with 12 leaves of full-page autotype plates (DAAO catalogue), text lithographed in sepia within decorative borders, cloth gilt, bevelled boards, all edges gilt. Ferguson 12513. I found no later issue or facsimile.

first_value_sold.note: Described as 1879 first edition, folio, autotype plates, all edges gilt

titles_read.reason: Bevelled gilt cloth folio with Autotype/London plates matches the 1879 description; no later edition found. Whole-book signs of age and the pasted 1930s newspaper clippings on the rear inside board mean this copy has been used as a scrapbook.
titles_read.check_at_viewing: Count the 12 plates (photos show Hobart from Proctor's Road, South Arm, Herne Bay, Wine-glass Bay, Cape Raoul: 5 of 12) and check the title page for Walch and Ward 1879. Check for rear pastedown/endpaper loss, gilt edges, loose hinges, foxing and the mould spotting on the cover. Condition: front board mottled with mould/spotting, spine ends frayed, sagging hinge.

lots.lot_verdict: Worth bidding. Two ABA hammer results $700 and $750 (2024) for the 1879 first. This copy is worn (mouldy cover, frayed spine ends, rear board covered with clippings) so ceiling hammer about $450 to $500 if plates are complete; drop to $300 if any plates are missing. Rear clippings (Wedd and Halloran glider tests, The Mercury 14 July 1930) are a small local-history bonus.
